headline: 11 as 1 for an audience of 1
bodyCopy: The Royals worked through a rebuilding season under coach Luke Shiderly, finishing 3-12 but earning key victories despite injuries. Jay Parrish led the offense with 12 goals and a team-high 28 points, while Blake Dale contributed 7 goals.
roster: Jay Parrish; Blake Dale; Cam Smithson; Harrison Schlabach; Isaiah McCluskey; James Baxter; David Sagers; Noah Barbrow
coaches: Luke Shiderly; Josh Kline; Aaron Dale; Pat Parrish
quotes: Best season ever — Jay Parrish; Worth every minute — Blake Dale
highlights: Won October 30 vs Polytech 4-1; Parrish hat trick; 130 saves by McCluskey

headline: Walking in faith together
bodyCopy: Chapel and community groups gave us the chance to connect with God through worship and prayer. We gathered as a group to pray for each other and grow together in faith.
quotes: What really stood out to me was how we all got to connect with our community leaders — Barbara; I love the worship during chapel — Allie Bennett

bodyCopy: This year our teams didn't just compete. They grew together and built something lasting.
